facts.fact: The DGI's e-impots portal handles online filing and payment of taxes for companies, and has been mandatory since early 2018 for those with turnover of 200 million FCFA or more, per CGECI.
Use of the e-impots portal has been mandatory since the start of 2018 for companies with turnover of 200 million or more, per CGECI.
